title: Bones of Grakkarond
wikitext:
[[File:Bones of Grakkarond.jpg|thumb|Bones of Grakkarond]]

The '''Bones of Grakkarond''' lie in central [[Silithus]]. They are the huge bones of the [[Bronze Dragon]] [[Grakkarond]], who died during the [[War of the Shifting Sands]].

He was slain by [[Ossirian the Unscarred]].

==Patch changes==
* [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.4.0 (2005-04-19):''' The dragon bones just to the southwest of The Swarming Pillar in Silithus have been named the Bones of Grakkarond.
